semanticColors.name: --color-ink
semanticColors.purpose: Text, primary action fill, focus ring, selection.

semanticColors.name: --color-wash

semanticColors.purpose: Error borders and messages; the only hue.

display.purpose: The Owner's name and Page titles.

title.purpose: Role titles, panel titles and list rows.

lede.purpose: The supporting line under a Page title, in secondary ink.

body.purpose: Summaries and supporting lines in secondary ink, 68ch measure.

small.purpose: Captions, notes and metadata in muted ink; row links and controls at 600.

label.purpose: Martian Mono for stat labels and dates (uppercase, 0.08em); chips and code set as-is.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating surfaces only (menus, popovers). Ring: ink 6% on paper, bone 30% on night. Shadow: ink 22% on paper, black 60% on night, the one non-ink colour, because no ink is darker than the night ground; the ring keeps floats legible there.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Controls, row links, switch options. 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Panel hover edge and wash. 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: duration-theme
motion.purpose: Theme crossfade of every token at once. 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing: exponential ease-out, no bounce.

states.name: error
states.purpose: Fields in error, with a Small message in error.

narrative.overview:
The Portfolio's Visual language is a dark, confident engineering page where bold, tightly tracked type and hairline panels carry the authority and the facts lead. The Owner stays in the background: a small, plain photo beside the name, never a portrait as the centrepiece.

The system is monochrome bone and ink. Dark is the default, always: a near-black ground carries warm bone ink. The complete light theme puts the same ink on bone paper and appears only when the visitor picks it in the dark and light switch, never from the system preference. Every colour token resolves both themes through `light-dark()`, so the active colour scheme picks one. Secondary text, metadata, hairlines and tints are the ink itself at fixed alpha steps; there is no hued accent anywhere. The primary action is the ink, filled; focus is an ink ring. The only hue in the system is error.

About me has its own, entirely distinct Visual language. It restyles the shared navigation, language toggle and Footer through tokens alone; their place and behavior never change.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default, always; light a complete equal the visitor switches to; both WCAG 2.2 AA.
Monochrome: bone ink on near-black, ink on bone paper, secondary ink and hairlines by alpha steps of the ink.
No hued accent: the primary action is filled ink, every other action is outlined in a hairline, focus is an ink ring.
Bold display grotesk with tight tracking; monospace only for labels, tags, chips and numerals.
Hairline-bordered panel grids whose cells share borders, instead of cards and shadows.
Facts over the person: a hairline facts panel leads Home, the photo stays small.

rules.name: The Ink Is The Action Rule
rules.body: There is no accent colour. The primary action is the ink filled, with the ground as its text: one per view. Secondary actions are outlined in Hairline Control. Focus is an ink ring. If a view needs colour to show what to do next, the hierarchy is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Alpha Steps Rule
rules.body: Secondary, muted, hairline and tint colours are always the ink mixed toward transparent at their fixed steps (84, 64, 26, 22, 10, 7, 4), and the Wash is the ink at 2% mixed into the ground; never new greys. The exceptions are few and named: input borders, set per theme to hold 3:1 (52% ink on paper, 44% bone on night); the raised surfaces (Night Raised, Paper Raised); and the float shadow, whose ring and shadow are the ink at 6% and 22% on paper and bone at 30% over black at 60% on night, because no ink is darker than the night ground.

rules.name: The Only Hue Is Error Rule
rules.body: Error is the sole hued colour, and it appears only where something went wrong.

rules.name: The Two Equal Themes Rule
rules.body: Every colour token exists in both themes and passes AA in both; dark is designed first, never light inverted.

rules.name: The Mono Labels Rule
rules.body: Monospace sets labels, tags, chips and numerals, never sentences or headings, and never as an eyebrow above a heading: the heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Reach for a hairline or a tint step first; a shadow is the last resort and only for something floating above the page.

dos: Do design the dark theme first and keep the light theme a complete equal, both at WCAG 2.2 AA.
Do open every Page in dark; show light only after the visitor picks it in the switch.
Do make the one primary action per view filled ink, and outline every other action in a hairline.
Do derive every secondary, muted, hairline and tint colour from the ink at its fixed alpha step.
Do lead Home with the facts in a hairline panel (role, seniority, location, work model, technologies) and keep the Owner's photo small and plain beside the name.
Do take every visual value from tokens, so About me can restyle the shared navigation, language toggle and Footer through tokens alone.
Do give every component all its states (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, and loading, error or success where they apply) before it counts as done.
Do keep motion to short expo ease-out transitions (150ms for controls, 200ms for panels, 240ms for the theme crossfade), no bounce, and 0ms under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce a hued accent, a gradient or a multi-colour palette; the Owner turned down every one offered.
Don't use error red for anything but errors.
Don't follow the system colour scheme preference; the Owner chose dark always by default.
Don't build a template portfolio: no avatar hero, no skill pills, no grid of identical project cards.
Don't set a monospace eyebrow above a heading, or monospace prose.
Don't make the Owner's photo a centrepiece: no large portrait, no colour effects, no full-bleed photo.
Don't put a shadow on anything that doesn't float above the page.
Don't let expression cost the 30-second read: role, seniority, technologies, location, CV and contact stay findable at a glance.
